description.narrative:
The objective of the project is to contribute to the healthcare system strengthening in Sokoto State through fostering excellence in medical education and development of resilient and quality healthcare and pharmaceutical infrastructure.
The project`s main activities to:
- Enhance Medical Education and Training through the construction and equipping of 3 faculties, library and 2 hostels for the College of Medical Sciences under the Sokoto State University to address health workforce shortages, improve public health outcomes, advance research capabilities, foster innovation in healthcare delivery.
- Enhance healthcare supply chain resilience through the construction of Zonal Medical Warehouse with the state-of-the-art medical equipment meeting international quality standards and requirements.
- Improve access to quality of healthcare services to 6,391,000 people in the Sokoto State.
